title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free
notes: Its output cap equals its whole context window, so it is the lane for emitting a file larger than 128k tokens. It publishes no effort level, so it spends nothing on reasoning. It is usually the quickest lane on the tier - 3.7s average over four requests - but one measured call took 114s, so it is not on a latency-sensitive path.
